WITH tmp_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY _loaded_at DESC) AS rn
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'orders') }} AS o
)
SELECT
  order_id,
  customer_id,
  order_ts,
  LOWER(TRIM(status)) AS status,
  channel,
  promo_code
FROM tmp_ranked
WHERE
  rn = 1

WITH tmp_first AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    CAST(MIN(order_ts) AS DATE) AS first_order_date
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
  WHERE
    NOT customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.region,
  c.segment,
  c.signup_date,
  c.marketing_opt_in,
  f.first_order_date
FROM {{ source('raw', 'customers') }} AS c
LEFT JOIN tmp_first AS f
  ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id

SELECT
  CAST(paid_ts AS DATE) AS revenue_date,
  SUM(amount) AS gross_revenue,
  COUNT(*) AS payments
FROM {{ source('raw', 'payments') }}
WHERE
  amount > 0
GROUP BY
  1

SELECT
  product_id,
  category,
  list_price,
  CASE
    WHEN list_price < 50
    THEN 'budget'
    WHEN list_price < 200
    THEN 'mid'
    ELSE 'premium'
  END AS price_band
FROM {{ source('raw', 'products') }}
WHERE
  is_active

SELECT
  COALESCE(promo_code, 'none') AS promo_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS buyers
FROM {{ source('raw', 'orders') }}
GROUP BY
  1

SELECT
  CAST(paid_ts AS DATE) AS refund_date,
  -SUM(amount) AS refunded,
  COUNT(*) AS refunds
FROM {{ source('raw', 'payments') }}
WHERE
  method = 'refund'
GROUP BY
  1

WITH tmp_sold AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS units_sold
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'order_items') }} AS i
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'products') }} AS p
    USING (product_id)
  GROUP BY
    1
), tmp_ret AS (
  SELECT
    p.category,
    SUM(r.quantity) AS units_returned
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'returns') }} AS r
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'orders') }} AS o
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id AND o._loaded_at = o.order_ts
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'products') }} AS p
    ON p.product_id = r.product_id
  WHERE
    r.return_ts <= o.order_ts + INTERVAL '60' DAY
  GROUP BY
    1
)
SELECT
  s.category,
  s.units_sold,
  COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) AS units_returned,
  ROUND(COALESCE(r.units_returned, 0) * 1.0 / s.units_sold, 4) AS return_rate
FROM tmp_sold AS s
LEFT JOIN tmp_ret AS r
  USING (category)

SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', return_ts) AS DATE) AS month,
  reason,
  SUM(quantity) AS units
FROM {{ source('raw', 'returns') }}
GROUP BY
  1,
  2

WITH tmp_sessions AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', started_at) AS DATE) AS month,
    source,
    pageviews
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'web_sessions') }}
)
SELECT
  month,
  source,
  COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  SUM(pageviews) AS pageviews
FROM tmp_sessions
GROUP BY
  month,
  source

WITH tmp_cat AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', o.order_ts) AS DATE) AS month,
    p.category,
    SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'order_items') }} AS i
  JOIN {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }} AS o
    ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'products') }} AS p
    ON p.product_id = i.product_id
  WHERE
    o.status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  month,
  category,
  revenue,
  ROUND(revenue / SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY month), 4) AS share_of_month
FROM tmp_cat

WITH tmp_q AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('QUARTER', order_ts) AS DATE) AS quarter,
    channel,
    COUNT(*) AS orders
  FROM {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }}
  WHERE
    status <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
), tmp_q_tot AS (
  SELECT
    quarter,
    SUM(orders) AS total_orders
  FROM tmp_q
  GROUP BY
    quarter
)
SELECT
  q.quarter,
  q.channel,
  q.orders,
  ROUND(q.orders * 1.0 / t.total_orders, 4) AS share
FROM tmp_q AS q
JOIN tmp_q_tot AS t
  USING (quarter)

WITH tmp_items AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS gross_amount,
    SUM(quantity) AS units
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'order_items') }}
  GROUP BY
    order_id
), tmp_pay AS (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount > 0 THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS captured,
    SUM(CASE WHEN amount < 0 THEN -amount ELSE 0 END) AS refunded
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'payments') }}
  GROUP BY
    order_id
)
SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  o.order_ts,
  o.status,
  o.channel,
  i.gross_amount,
  i.units,
  COALESCE(p.captured, 0) AS captured,
  COALESCE(p.refunded, 0) AS refunded,
  COALESCE(p.captured, 0) - COALESCE(p.refunded, 0) AS net_revenue
FROM {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }} AS o
JOIN tmp_items AS i
  ON i.order_id = o.order_id
LEFT JOIN tmp_pay AS p
  ON p.order_id = o.order_id

WITH tmp_seq AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    order_ts,
    LEAD(order_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id) AS next_ts,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_ts, order_id) AS n
  FROM {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }}
  WHERE
    NOT customer_id IS NULL AND status <> 'cancelled'
)
SELECT
  CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
  COUNT(*) AS new_buyers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN next_ts <= order_ts + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_30d,
  (
    SUM(CASE WHEN next_ts <= order_ts + INTERVAL '30' DAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100
  ) // COUNT(*) AS repeat_pct
FROM tmp_seq
WHERE
  n = 1
GROUP BY
  1

SELECT
  o.order_id,
  o.customer_id,
  o.order_ts,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT
        s.source
      FROM {{ source('raw', 'web_sessions') }} AS s
      WHERE
        s.customer_id = o.customer_id
        AND s.started_at <= o.order_ts
        AND s.started_at > o.order_ts - INTERVAL '7' DAY
      ORDER BY
        s.started_at DESC,
        s.session_id DESC
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    'unattributed'
  ) AS last_touch_source
FROM {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }} AS o
WHERE
  NOT o.customer_id IS NULL AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

WITH tmp_units AS (
  SELECT
    c.region,
    i.product_id,
    SUM(i.quantity) AS units
  FROM {{ source('raw', 'order_items') }} AS i
  JOIN {{ ref('stg_orders_clean') }} AS o
    ON o.order_id = i.order_id
  JOIN {{ source('raw', 'customers') }} AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY
    1,
    2
)
SELECT
  region,
  product_id,
  units,
  rnk
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY units DESC, product_id) AS rnk
  FROM tmp_units
)
WHERE
  rnk <= 5

WITH tmp_agg AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    COUNT(*) AS lifetime_orders,
    SUM(net_revenue) AS lifetime_net_revenue,
    CAST(MIN(order_ts) AS DATE) AS first_order,
    CAST(MAX(order_ts) AS DATE) AS last_order
  FROM {{ ref('order_totals') }}
  WHERE
    status <> 'cancelled' AND NOT customer_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    customer_id
)
SELECT
  d.customer_id,
  d.region,
  d.segment,
  COALESCE(a.lifetime_orders, 0) AS lifetime_orders,
  COALESCE(a.lifetime_net_revenue, 0) AS lifetime_net_revenue,
  a.first_order,
  a.last_order
FROM {{ ref('dim_customers') }} AS d
LEFT JOIN tmp_agg AS a
  ON a.customer_id = d.customer_id
